scripts.start: ng build classic-editor && ng build task-workspace && ng serve
scripts.build: ng build classic-editor && ng build task-workspace && ng build classic-editor-ws
scripts.pack:lib: ng build classic-editor && npm pack ./dist/classic-editor && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('releases',{recursive:true});fs.renameSync('classic-editor-0.1.0.tgz','releases/classic-editor-0.1.0.tgz');console.log('→ releases/classic-editor-0.1.0.tgz')"
scripts.pack:task-workspace: ng build task-workspace && npm pack ./dist/task-workspace && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('releases',{recursive:true});fs.renameSync('task-workspace-0.1.0.tgz','releases/task-workspace-0.1.0.tgz');console.log('→ releases/task-workspace-0.1.0.tgz')"
